article.title: Pika預覽Enact，以拖曳角色及鏡頭控制引導影片生成
article.summary: Pika公布Enact研究預覽，展示在影音生成過程中持續修改場景的實驗性介面。
highlights: 示範包括用滑鼠移動角色或物件、用語音指導表演，以及控制鏡頭。
Enact尚未向消費者開放使用，Pika提供研究及整合洽詢渠道。
article.why: 即時走位及鏡頭控制把生成提示變成持續導演操作，製作團隊可先盤點哪些廣告概念需要這類互動控制。
article.next_step: 列出一段涉及人物走位的鏡頭需求，記下需要控制的位置、表演及鏡頭路徑，作為研究試用開放後的評估條件。
article.detail: Pika表示，Enact建於H3 Flex，以短片段串流生成畫面和聲音，同時帶入新的導演指令。研究展示讓角色在影片播放中移動，並讓鏡頭按操作改變方向。團隊可把這些示範轉成具體的測試問題，例如物件移位後是否保持場景關係，再追蹤研究試用和整合機會。
article.title_en: Pika previews Enact for directing generation with actor and camera controls
article.summary_en: Pika unveiled Enact, an experimental interface for changing scenes during audiovisual generation.
highlights_en: Demos cover dragging actors or objects, spoken performance direction and camera control.
It remains unavailable to consumers, with research and integration inquiries offered by Pika.
article.why_en: Live staging turns prompts into ongoing direction. Production teams can identify concepts needing those controls.
article.next_step_en: Specify actor positions, performance notes and a camera path as evaluation criteria for any future research access.
article.detail_en: Pika says Enact streams short audiovisual chunks on H3 Flex while taking new direction. Demonstrations move subjects during playback and change camera direction. Turn them into test questions, such as whether moved objects retain their scene relationships, while tracking research access.
